about.title: About Sai Teja
about.content: I'm Sai Teja — a backend and AI engineer with 3+ years building distributed systems, enterprise platforms, and AI-powered products. I care about writing clean, efficient code and understanding the system end-to-end, not just the layer I own. Currently at Dhan AI, I've shipped across customer portals, internal operations tooling, and a large-scale multi-tenant CXP platform. I'm drawn to hard problems — event-driven architectures, microservice coordination, and systems that need to be resilient at scale. I'm equally deep into AI engineering — building with LLMs, RAG pipelines, and autonomous agents. I've worked with retrieval-augmented systems, prompt-engineered production workflows, and I actively track the frontier of open-source AI. For me, the most exciting work happens where backend systems meet AI — building the infrastructure that makes models useful in the real world.

experience.description: Leading the development of highly scalable distributed backend systems and AI-powered features. I work on a variety of critical platforms including customer-facing portals, internal operations management tools, and a complex multi-tenant Customer Experience (CXP) platform. My work involves architecting microservices that handle high throughput, designing LLM-integrated workflows, and ensuring system reliability through event-driven patterns.
highlights: Shipped 15+ high-impact microservices across the enterprise CXP platform
Optimized system performance, achieving a 30% improvement in API response times
Architected and implemented event-driven systems using Apache Kafka for seamless service coordination
Integrated enterprise-grade solutions including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Firebase RBAC
Built a proactive network diagnostics engine to detect and resolve infrastructure issues automatically

experience.description: Focused on Python-based automation and security tooling. I developed scripts to streamline security workflows and performed vulnerability assessments to enhance system integrity.
highlights: Developed Python scripting for automated security workflows
Conducted vulnerability assessments and security tooling development

experience.description: Completed an intensive Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) training program. This period was foundational in building the algorithmic thinking and problem-solving skills I apply to complex system design today.
highlights: Completed intensive DSA curriculum covering advanced topics
Developed strong problem-solving and algorithmic reasoning capabilities
Built the foundation for efficient software engineering and system design

experience.description: Gained practical experience in threat analysis and security tooling during a hands-on internship. Learned the fundamentals of cybersecurity and how to apply them in a professional setting.
highlights: Conducted threat analysis and identified potential security risks

projects.title: Customer Self-Service Portal
projects.description: A customer-facing platform enabling users to view and manage active services in real time. Architected as a middleware microservice layer, bridging the frontend with multiple external service providers — handling auth, session management, and data orchestration.
projects.impact: Real-time service management for enterprise telecom customers

projects.title: Agent Operations Platform
projects.description: Internal tooling for support agents to manage services and handle trouble tickets end-to-end. Built a proactive network diagnostics engine that detects and resolves infrastructure issues before customers are impacted — reducing dispatches and cutting resolution costs.
projects.impact: Reduced support dispatches and infrastructure resolution costs

projects.title: Enterprise CXP Platform
projects.description: Modernized a large-scale customer experience platform with 15+ microservices powering onboarding, billing, payments, and order lifecycle. Delivered 30% improvement in API response times. Integrated Salesforce, Dynamics 365, and Firebase RBAC.
projects.impact: 30% improvement in API response times; 15+ microservices shipped

contact.availability: Open for backend engineering, AI/ML engineering, and full-stack AI roles. Whether it's building production LLM systems, distributed architectures, or something at the intersection — my inbox is always open.
